answer: Stop sybils with the One-Roof Registry: one voting identity per cluster. First, it groups signups by wallet, device fingerprint, and network range, so clones sharing a roof land together. Second, a cluster keeps one vote until a second identity proves a separate device, funds, and 30 days of distinct work. Third, a cluster caught hiding a clone loses its $2,000 bond and waits 90 days to reapply. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 devices, $20 million in bonds, and 300,000 days of staged work. Like a grove on one dune, a thousand trunks mean nothing when they share one hollow root system.
